target_moa.text: Triazaacenaphthylene bacterial type II topoisomerase inhibitor that inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV, thereby inhibiting DNA replication

citations.quote: BLUJEPa is a triazaacenaphthylene antibacterial that inhibits Type II topoisomerases including bacterial topoisomerase II (DNA gyrase) and topoisomerase IV, thereby inhibiting DNA replication.

Gepotidacin (GSK2140944) is a triazaacenaphthylene bacterial Type II topoisomerase inhibitor that selectively inhibits Type II bacterial topoisomerases, namely deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) gyrase and topoisomerase IV.
BLUJ EPA tablets contain gepotidacin mesylate, a triazaacenaphthylene antibacterial that inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (\ge1%): diarrhea (16% vs 3% nitrofurantoin), nausea (9% vs 4%), abdominal pain (4% vs 2%), flatulence (3%), headache (2%), soft feces (2%), dizziness (2%), vomiting (2%), and vulvovaginal candidiasis (1%). One serious adverse reaction of dysarthria attributed to gepotidacin; no deaths. Discontinuations for AEs 79/1,570 (5%) vs 30/1,558 (2%).
